title: [failed] TC-001-06: Each list item includes post metadata (title/filename, date if available)
description:
Test case TC-001-06 resulted in status: failed.
Notes: Test failure caused by timezone-sensitive date formatting: toLocaleDateString converts UTC midnight to local date which can shift by -1 day. The PostCard component itself renders metadata correctly (title, date, preview) as proven by PostCard unit tests.
Evidence: components/__tests__/PostCard.test.tsx: 4/4 tests pass (renders title, formatted date, preview). However app/__tests__/page.test.tsx: 'shows title and date for each post' FAILS — test expects 'Jan 15, 2025' but component renders 'Jan 14, 2025' due to timezone offset in toLocaleDateString for '2025-01-15T00:00:00Z' in test environment. PostCard component correctly renders metadata but page-level integration test fails.
Correlated requirements: US-001

title: [failed] TC-002-01: Post page fetches Gist content for slug and renders as Markdown
description:
Test case TC-002-01 resulted in status: failed. Notes: The post page correctly fetches Gist content by slug and renders it as Markdown via PostContent. The test failure is due to an ambiguous getByRole query — both the page title h1 and the markdown content h1 match. The 'renders a back link' and markdown rendering tests in other suites pass, confirming the feature works. Evidence: app/posts/[slug]/__tests__/page.test.tsx: 'renders post when slug maps to a Gist' FAILS — test uses screen.getByRole('heading', {level:1}) but finds 2 h1 elements: the post title

Hello World

and a markdown-rendered

Hello World

from content '# Hello World\n\nContent here.'. TestingLibraryElementError: 'Found multiple elements with the role heading'. The feature works correctly (content IS fetched and rendered as Markdown), but the test selector is ambiguous. Correlated requirements: US-002, FR-5
